scope: Fifteen IMA September 2026 critical-element mineral species (petersenite-(Ce), lukechangite-(Ce), qaqarssukite-(Ce), calkinsite-(Ce), horvathite-(Y), sheldrickite, sabinaite, gaidonnayite, gittinsite, lemoynite, natrolemoynite, weloganite, bijvoetite-(Y), retzian-(Nd), okanoganite-(Y)) with 100% primary-source visual inspection across all IMA-cited references and five bounded laboratory thermal dehydration/decarbonation mechanisms. Seven additional investigated candidates with an unacquired secondary/original reference are explicitly deferred.

selection.reason: Missing IMA:1992-048 Ce-dominant sodium-rare-earth carbonate Na4Ce2(CO3)5 from Mont Saint-Hilaire (cotype CMN 81511); complete CM 32 (1994) 405-414 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 170 inspected.

Missing IMA:1996-033 Ce-dominant sodium-rare-earth fluorocarbonate Na3Ce2(CO3)4F from Mont Saint-Hilaire (cotype CMNMI 81535); complete AM 82 (1997) 1255-1260 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 129 inspected.

Missing IMA:2004-019 Ce-dominant barium-rare-earth fluorocarbonate BaCe(CO3)2F from Qaqarssuk carbonatite complex, Greenland (cotypes CMNMC 84398 and 84399); complete CM 44 (2006) 1137-1146 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 180 inspected.

Missing 1987 s.p. (Rn) Ce-dominant hydrated rare-earth carbonate Ce2(CO3)3.4H2O from Bearpaw Mountains, Montana; complete AM 38 (1953) 1169-1183 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 36 inspected.

Missing IMA:1996-032 Y-dominant sodium-yttrium fluorocarbonate NaY(CO3)F2 from Mont Saint-Hilaire (cotype CMNMI 81536); complete CM 35 (1997) 743-749 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 96 inspected.

Missing IMA:1996-019 hydrated sodium-calcium fluorocarbonate NaCa3(CO3)2F3(H2O) from Mont Saint-Hilaire (cotypes CMNMI 81530, 81537-81539); complete CM 35 (1997) 181-187 primary PDF inspected, including N2 TGA 160-265 C single-step dehydration.

Missing IMA:1978-071 sodium-zirconium-titanium oxycarbonate Na4TiZr2O4(CO3)4 from Francon quarry and Mont Saint-Hilaire; complete CM 18 (1980) 25-29 and CM 34 (1996) 811-815 primary PDFs inspected, including DTA-TGA two-stage decarbonation to ZrO2.

Missing IMA:1973-008 hydrated sodium-zirconium silicate Na2ZrSi3O9(H2O)2 from Mont Saint-Hilaire (cotypes NMC T73/2-1 and T73/2-2); complete CM 12 (1974) 316-319, CM 23 (1985) 11-15, and CM 24 (1986) 417-419 primary PDFs inspected, including TGA irreversible dehydration and 450-1000 C transformation to wadeite-like Na2ZrSi3O9.

Missing IMA:1979-034 calcium-zirconium pyrosilicate CaZrSi2O7 from Kipawa River complex and Strange Lake; complete CM 18 (1980) 201-203 and CM 27 (1989) 703-708 primary PDFs and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 83 inspected.

Missing IMA:1968-013 hydrated sodium-calcium-zirconium silicate Na2CaZr2Si10O26(H2O)5-6 from Mont Saint-Hilaire; complete CM 9 (1969) 585-596 and CM 14 (1976) 132-138 primary PDFs inspected, including 135-200 C channel dehydration with unchanged ZrSi5O13 framework.

Missing IMA:1996-063 Na-dominant hydrated zirconium silicate Na4Zr2Si10O26(H2O)7.2H2O from Mont Saint-Hilaire (holotype CNMMI 81534); complete CM 39 (2001) 1295-1306 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 152 inspected.

Missing IMA:1967-042 hydrated sodium-strontium-zirconium carbonate Na2Sr3Zr(CO3)6(H2O)3 from Francon quarry, Montreal; complete CM 9 (1968) 468-477 and CM 13 (1975) 209-216 primary PDFs inspected, including multi-stage DTA-TGA thermal decomposition to SrCO3 and SrZrO3.

Missing 1987 s.p. (Rn) Y-dominant hydrated uranyl rare-earth carbonate Y8(UO2)16O8(CO3)16(OH)8(H2O)25.14H2O from Shinkolobwe, DRC (holotype RGM 13.781); complete CM 20 (1982) 231-238 and CM 38 (2000) 153-162 primary PDFs and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 26 inspected.

Missing 1982 s.p. (status A) Nd-dominant manganese rare-earth hydroxy-arsenate Mn2+2Nd(AsO4)(OH)4 from Sterling Hill mine, New Jersey (holotype NMNH 143762); complete AM 67 (1982) 841-845 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 184 inspected.

Missing 1987 s.p. (Rn) Y-dominant rare-earth borosilicate-fluoride (Y,REE,Ca,Na,Th)16(Fe3+,Ti)(Si,B,P)10(O,OH)38F10 from Golden Horn batholith, Washington; complete AM 65 (1980) 1138-1142 and AM 89 (2004) 1540-1545 primary PDFs and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 158 inspected.

deferred_candidates.reason: Original description (Can. Mineral. 16 (1978), 561, CM16_561.pdf) inspected in full, but the second IMA reference (Ghose et al. 1987, Am. Mineral. 72:365-374) and the 1998 high-temperature Na-cebaite/calciohilairite transformation study (J. Phys. Chem. B 102 (1998), 9401) are not in the open RRUFF archive; deferred until full primary PDFs for all cited studies are acquired.

Crystal-structure paper (Am. Mineral. 72 (1987), 1230, AM72_1230.pdf) inspected in full, but original species description (Pagoaga et al. 1986, Mineral. Mag. 50:125-129) is paywalled; deferred to preserve 100% primary-source inspection.

Original 1982 description (Can. Mineral. 20 (1982), 231, CM20_231.pdf) inspected in full, but the second IMA reference redefining the cage-cluster structure (Olds et al. 2025, Mineral. Mag. 89:511) is not locally available in full text; deferred.

Original 1959 description (Am. Mineral. 44 (1959), 839, AM44_839.pdf) inspected in full, but the 2013 crystal-structure and formula-redefinition paper (Plasil et al. 2013, Am. Mineral. 98:718) is not in the open archive; deferred.

2000 crystal-structure refinement (Can. Mineral. 38 (2000), 737, CM38_737.pdf) inspected in full, but original 1924 Buttgenbach description (Ann. Soc. Geol. Belgique 47:C41) is not available in full text; deferred.

1999 crystal-structure refinement (Can. Mineral. 37 (1999), 1003, CM37_1003.pdf) inspected in full, but original 1947 Vaes description (Ann. Soc. Geol. Belgique 70:B212) is not available in full text; deferred.
Original 1978 description (Am. Mineral. 63 (1978), 1162, AM63_1162.pdf) inspected in full, but the 1979 crystal-structure paper (Acta Crystallogr. B35 (1979), 147) is paywalled; deferred.

deduplication.note: No pre-existing owner record in data/records/ matched any of the 15 selected mineral species prior to Round 118 creation.
